title: Latency and timeouts on node-svc

detection.alert: node-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on node-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] node-svc 2026-05-13 19:30-00:10: node-svc: 293 of 405 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-13 19:30 and 2026-05-14 00:10 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 4 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: ciod: Error loading <*> invalid or missing program image, Exec format error

_templates.macro: Config change to {key} in {svc} broke calls under load.

culprit.diff:
@@ -21,3 +21,3 @@ retry.max
 retry:
-  max_attempts: 3
+  max_attempts: 15
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change to retry.max in node-svc broke calls under load.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `outbound call failed after <*> attempts`.
